decision: held: no declared source has open full text (20554904, 36043374, 23472020; no PMC records). 23472020 (broiler-chicken aflatoxin study) is now recorded only as explicitly labelled animal research (rejected_source), never human clinical evidence. Dr. Pham rejects cross-preparation/outcome transfer, and the dry-eye oil RCT and the metabolic meta-analysis cannot be dose- or preparation-verified from abstracts alone. OA retry 2026-10-28: 36043374 closed; 20554904 bronze copy blocked.
summary: 20554904 abstract: 100 adults with dry eye, 2 g/day sea buckthorn oil versus placebo oil for 3 months (86 completed); smaller rise in tear osmolarity (ITT P=0.04). 36043374 abstract: 15 RCTs; lower triglycerides, TC and LDL-C and higher HDL-C, only in people with abnormal lipids; no effect on glucose, BP or BMI. 23472020: chickens, not humans.

limitations: Animal research: broiler chickens given aflatoxin B1 with or without sea buckthorn berry oil. Never human clinical evidence for this record (Dr. Pham third ruling set, 2026-10-28).
